label: Moxa EDS-G4008-LV-T
description: Moxa EDS-G4008-LV-T - 8-port full-Gigabit managed switch: eight 10/100/1000BaseT(X) RJ45 ports, no SFP cages and no PoE. Layer 2 with Turbo Ring/Turbo Chain, 8.84 W maximum consumption on the wide-temperature -T build.
notes: Switch properties, from the same datasheet: 16 K MAC table, 9.216 KB jumbo frames, 256 VLANs (VID 1 to 4094), 512 IGMP groups, 4 priority queues, 1 MB packet buffer. Console is a front-panel RS-232 8-pin RJ45 at 115200 n 8 1 (TxD, RxD, GND) - not modelled as an interface, because a console carries no frames. One alarm relay (1 A @ 24 VDC) and one digital input, a USB Type A port marked Reserved, IP40 metal case on DIN rail, wall-mount kit optional. Power comes from a removable module: PWR-100-LV (9.6 to 60 VDC, redundant dual inputs on the -LV models) or PWR-105-HV-I (88 to 300 VDC / 85 to 264 VAC, single input), which is why the ordering name carries the module (-LV/-HV) and the chassis name does not. The datasheet publishes no switching-capacity or forwarding-rate figure at all, so no fabric is declared here rather than a number guessed from the port count. Consumption 8.84 W maximum for the EDS-G4008-LV/-LV-T (10.73 W for the -HV build), 55 x 140 x 122.5 mm, -40 to 75 C on this -T model. No model in this series has PoE or a fibre cage - the PoE and uplink variants live in the EDS-G4012 series. Firmware for the whole EDS-4000/EDS-G4000 family is Moxa's next-generation switch OS v4.x, listed as firmware v4.2 (2026-03-20) on the series download page (https://www.moxa.com/en/products/industrial-network-infrastructure/ethernet-switches/layer-2-managed-switches/eds-g4008-series).
